'''Aline Gouget Morin''' (born 1977){{r|born}} is a French mathematician and cryptographer whose works include contributions to the design of the [[SOSEMANUK]] stream cipher{{r|sosemanuk}} and [[Shabal]] hash algorithm,{{r|shabal}} and methods for anonymized [[digital currency]].{{r|ecash}} She is a researcher for [[Gemalto]], an international digital security company.{{r|gem}}

==Education==
Gouget completed a PhD in 2004 at the [[University of Caen Normandy]]. Her dissertation, ''Etude de propriétés cryptographiques des fonctions booléennes et algorithme de confusion pour le chiffrement symétrique'', was advised by Claude Carlet.{{r|diss}}

==Recognition==
In 2017, Gouget was the winner of the [[Irène Joliot-Curie Prize]] in the category for women in business and technology.{{r|ijc}}
